 SSC exam dates announced for CGEPT, Annual Departmental Typing Test, Stenographer Skill Test and Delhi Police SI; check details at ssc.gov.in
 SSC has announced the November 2026 exam schedule, including dates for CGEPT, departmental typing and stenographer skill tests, and the Delhi Police and CAPFs Sub-Inspector Paper II examination.
 Curated by Yash Wardhan Singh 
 Image: iStock 
 Nov 03, 2026
 Share
 The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the examination schedule for various exams taking place in November 2026. Candidates can visit the official SSC website, ssc.gov.in, to view and download the exam date notice. 
 According to the notification, the Coast Guard Enrolled Persons Test (CGEPT) for batches 01/2027 and 02/2027 will take place on November 17 and 18, 2026. The Annual Departmental Typing Test (English/Hindi) and Stenographer Skill Test (English/Hindi) Examination 2025 are scheduled for November 20 and 21, 2026. Meanwhile, the Sub-Inspector in Delhi Police and CAPFs Examination 2025 (Paper II) will be conducted on November 28, 2026. 
 The selection process for the Sub-Inspector post in Delhi Police includes Paper I, Physical Standard Test (PST), Physical Endurance Test (PET), Paper II and Detailed Medical Examination (DME). 
 How to check the exam dates 
 Candidates can follow these steps to download the SSC examination schedule: 
 1. Go to the official SSC website, ssc.gov.in. 
 2. Find and click on the examination notice link on the homepage. 
 3. The notice will open in PDF format. 
 4. Check the examination dates mentioned in the PDF. 
 5. Download the notice and save a copy for future reference. 
 Candidates can visit the official SSC website for more information and updates related to the examinations.
